title: Action space
description: What an MCP endpoint lets a program control and observe: every tool with its canonical role, arguments, risk and effect; the readable state; the job devices' plans. Returned by the native tool action_space() (asyncroscopy.mcp.action_space).

role.description: The agent endpoint hides operator-only tools.

roles.description: The canonical role vocabulary: role -> what a tool with that role does.

device.description: Tool prefix: the device's tools are <device>_<command>.

stem.description: Scans images and blanks a beam (an electron microscope).

probe.description: Brings a probe to the sample (approach, engage, indent).

envelope.description: Runs jobs through the job envelope (reserve ... release).

device.description: Tool prefix of the device; null for a native tool.

command.description: Tango command; null for a native tool.

role_source.description: annotation: the device's action_hints (a YAML role:); rule: from the command's words; default: other.

purpose.description: What the tool does, one line from its doc.

risk.description: As the approval gate sees it: approve mode holds high-risk calls.

effect.description: observe: only reads; act: may change the instrument or the sample.

primary.description: The instrument's main observable (a STEM's scanned image, a YAML instrument's map image).

source.description: tool: read it by calling `tool`; attribute: a Tango attribute (Tango clients; no MCP tool of its own).

plan_schema.description: The plan's JSON Schema; null when the device gives none.

plan_example.description: A valid plan for reserve or run_job.

run_with.description: The native tool that runs a whole job in one call.

value.description: An argument (with a name) or a return value.

type.description: JSON type (number, integer, string, boolean, array, object, or several joined by |), or 'data key'.

units.description: One unit, or one per element.

axis.description: The stage axis (x, y, z) this value is.

elements.description: What each element of an array is, e.g. [x, y, z, alpha, beta].

kind.description: An acquisition's data kind (image, spectrum, value).
